name: Bernadette Kowalski
tagline: Diner waitress for 22 years. Calls everyone 'hon'. Knows everybody's business.
bio: Bernie has worked the morning shift at the same diner for twenty-two years and can carry six plates and a conversation at once. She has a story about her cousin Darlene for every possible situation, most of them unbelievable, all of them true.
look: Cheerful woman in her mid 40s, big teased red hair, cat-eye glasses, pink diner uniform with a name tag reading BERNIE, pencil tucked behind her ear, chewing gum. Default expression: wide friendly grin.

voice.description: Bright, friendly middle-aged female voice; fast-talking and expressive, with a warm laugh.

game.start.text: Alright, hons, cards are up! Who wants coffee?
Ooh, I love a card game. My cousin Darlene once played Hearts for three days straight.
Okay sugar, deal 'em out. I'm on my break.

game.won.self.text: I won! Wait'll I tell Darlene. She's gonna be so jealous.

game.won.human.text: Look at you, hon! Big winner! That deserves a slice of pie.
Well, aren't you something! Nicely done, sugar.

game.won.other.text: Good game, hon! You earned it.

hand.good.self.text: Ha! Order up! One winning hand!
Now that's what I call a good shift.

hand.bad.self.text: Oof. That hand was like a Monday double shift.
Well, that went over like a cold cup of coffee.

hand.good.human.text: Ooh, look at you go, hon!

hand.bad.human.text: Aw, sugar. Happens to the best of us. Happens to Darlene a lot.

idle.human.text: Take your time, hon. Darlene once took twenty minutes to pick a card.
No rush, sugar. Want me to top off your coffee?

hearts.queen_taken.self.text: Oh, for crying out loud. Thirteen points! That's like a whole table of bad tippers.
Well, that's just my luck. Darlene would laugh so hard.

hearts.queen_taken.human.text: Oh, hon. I'm so sorry. Want a muffin?
Ooh, that's a rough one, sugar.

hearts.queen_taken.other.text: Oh honey, nobody wants her. Nobody!

hearts.queen_given.self.text: Here ya go, hon! Compliments of the house!
Special of the day: one Queen of Spades. Enjoy!

hearts.hearts_broken.self.text: Hearts are open, hons! Kitchen's hot!
Oops! Broke the hearts. Like Darlene's third husband.

hearts.jack_taken.self.text: The Jack! Now that's a good tip!

hearts.jack_taken.human.text: Nice one, sugar! Ten points off the bill!

hearts.moon_shot.self.text: I shot the moon! Somebody call Darlene!
Twenty-six for everybody! Sorry, hons, kitchen's closed!

hearts.moon_shot.human.text: You shot the moon?! Well, I'll be! Pie for you, on the house!

hearts.moon_shot.other.text: Well, I'll be darned. Good for you, hon.

hearts.moon_blocked.self.text: Oh, so close! That's like dropping the last plate on the tray.

hearts.moon_blocked.human.text: Aw, sugar, you almost had it!

hearts.moon_block.self.text: Sorry, hon! Can't let you have the whole pie!

hearts.pass.received.text: Ooh, what did you send me? Oh. Oh, sugar, no.

spades.bid_nil.self.text: Nil for me, hon. I'm on my break.
Goin' nil! Darlene says I can't do it. Watch me.

spades.bid_nil.partner.text: Nil? Ooh, brave! Don't worry, sugar, I've got you.
Okay hon, you sit pretty. I'll take the tricks.

spades.nil_made.self.text: Not one trick! Wait'll I tell Darlene!

spades.nil_made.partner.text: You did it, hon! Pie's on me!
Look at you, sugar! A perfect nil!

spades.nil_made.opponent.text: Well, good for you, hon. Credit where it's due.

spades.nil_failed.self.text: Oops! Took a trick. Like dropping a full tray.
There goes my nil. Darlene's gonna laugh.

spades.nil_failed.partner.text: Aw, sugar. Don't you worry about it.
Happens to the best of us, hon. Happens to Darlene weekly.

spades.nil_failed.opponent.text: Ooh, there goes your nil, hon! Sorry! Not sorry!
Nil's broken! Sending that one back to the kitchen.

spades.set.us.text: We got set, hon. Like a Monday double shift.
Oof. That went over like cold coffee.

spades.set.them.text: You got set, hon! Want some pie to feel better?

spades.bags.us.text: Too many bags! I'm a waitress, not a grocery store!
A bag penalty. Darlene does that every game.

spades.bags.them.text: Ooh, too many bags, sugar. That'll cost ya.

spades.trumped.partner.text: That's my partner! Big tip for you!

gin.gin.self.text: Gin! My cousin Darlene would be so proud. Or jealous.

gin.gin.human.text: Gin! Look at you, sugar! Pie's on the house.

gin.knock.self.text: I'm knockin', hon. Like the health inspector.

gin.knock.human.text: Knockin' already, hon? Let's see the check.
Ooh, a knock. Let's see what you cooked up.

gin.undercut.self.text: Ha! Darlene taught me that one. She cheats, but still.

gin.undercut.human.text: Undercut! You got me good, sugar.
Oof. Sent back to the kitchen.

gin.dead_hand.text: Nobody wins, hon. Like a slow Tuesday.
A dead hand. Let's call it a coffee break.

gin.took_discard.human.text: Oh, you wanted that one? It's all yours, sugar.
Takin' my leftovers, hon? There's plenty.

rummy.went_out.human.text: You're out already, hon? I barely wiped the counter.
Look at you, out already! Somebody get this one a pie.

rummy.caught.self.text: Caught with a full tray, hon. Story of my life.
All these cards! I'm holdin' more than the lunch rush.

rummy.caught.human.text: Oof, caught with a full hand, sugar.
That's a heavy tray, hon. Happens to everybody.

rummy.took_pile.self.text: I'll take the whole pile, hon. Family size.
Gimme all of it. I've carried twelve plates at once.

rummy.took_pile.human.text: The whole pile, hon? Somebody's hungry!
Takin' it all! Darlene does that at buffets.

rummy.layoff.human.text: Sure, hon, add it to my meld. Make yourself at home.
Puttin' your card on my meld? That's family-style.

rummy.big_meld.self.text: Look at that, hon! Blue plate special!
That's a big one! Like Darlene's hair in '88.

rummy.big_meld.human.text: Ooh, look at that meld, sugar!
Now that's a full order, hon!
